HasCanvas

The HasCanvas method returns a Boolean value that indicates whether this facet has its own canvas. 
ODBoolean HasCanvas ();
return value
kODTrue if this facet has its own canvas, otherwise kODFalse.

The ODFacet::ChangeCanvas method (page 233).
